coverage_note: Selected source context, not independent verification. Publication dates are distinct from the report date. Planning options are editorial follow-up suggestions.

domains.name: Benefits
domains.domain_context: Benefits navigation can connect eligible households with support across several services.
domains.planning_option: Check official VA and Social Security announcements before advising households about payment changes. A reported possibility is not a confirmed VA rate change.
domains.watch_next: Payment confirmation: Look for an official VA announcement establishing whether a 2027 adjustment applies, its effective date and payment timing.

domains.name: Military Family Readiness
domains.audience: Military households, spouses and family-support organizations
domains.domain_context: Family support and career continuity can be addressed together rather than through separate referrals.
domains.planning_option: If considering the source for care referrals, confirm eligibility, coverage, location and current availability with the provider first.
domains.watch_next: Family access: Look for household eligibility, participating locations and enrollment instructions for the support described. Spouse entrepreneurship: Check whether the linked article identifies business-support resources, eligibility requirements or startup steps useful after relocation.

domains.name: Cost of Living
domains.audience: Military and veteran households; assistance providers
domains.domain_context: Benefit access, housing costs and household budgets may need a joint response.
domains.planning_option: Review current assistance criteria and local capacity before directing households to financial support.
domains.watch_next: Spouse entrepreneurship: Check whether the linked article identifies business-support resources, eligibility requirements or startup steps useful after relocation.

domains.name: Housing Stability
domains.audience: Veterans facing housing instability; housing and community partners
domains.domain_context: Housing support can connect rental assistance with care and case management.
domains.planning_option: Review the underlying state's definition and coordination approach for lessons relevant to local housing partners; verify details with the responsible agencies.
domains.watch_next: Housing coordination: Verify the underlying state's definition, measurement period and referral-to-housing process before treating this as a model for local partners.

domains.name: Healthcare System
domains.domain_context: Care access should be considered alongside housing continuity and family support.
domains.planning_option: If considering the source for care referrals, confirm eligibility, coverage, location and current availability with the provider first.
domains.watch_next: Care delivery: Look for participating providers, insurance coverage, referral procedures and local appointment availability.

domains.name: Employment
domains.audience: Veterans, military spouses, employers and workforce partners
domains.domain_context: Career mobility can connect workforce policy, employers and military-family support.
domains.planning_option: Check occupation-specific licensing and credential-transfer rules in the relevant state before advising a career move.
domains.watch_next: Career portability: Look for state- and occupation-specific implementation dates, credential-transfer requirements and application instructions.
